results.title: General Manager – Land Transportation
results.description: Our client, a growing land transportation company based in Najran, Saudi Arabia, is seeking an entrepreneurial and commercially driven General Manager to lead the business through its next stage of growth. The role requires a business builder with a strong track record of growing and scaling transportation or logistics businesses. The successful candidate will have full responsibility for the company's strategic, commercial, operational, and financial performance, with a strong mandate to accelerate business development, market penetration, expansion, and modernization . Key Responsibilities Develop and execute a multi-year growth and expansion strategy to significantly strengthen the company's market position. Drive business development and market penetration through new customers, contracts, sectors, services, and strategic partnerships. Identify and evaluate opportunities for geographic expansion, service diversification, and fleet investment. Take full ownership of the company's P&L, revenue growth, profitability, cash flow, and overall business performance. Lead large-scale transportation and fleet operations, ensuring strong asset utilization, productivity, service reliability, and cost efficiency. Optimize fleet performance, maintenance, fuel consumption, route planning, capacity utilization, and operational KPIs. Lead commercial negotiations, contract pricing, customer management, and strategic account development. Drive the company's digitalization and modernization agenda , leveraging technology, data, automation, and modern transport/fleet management systems. Build scalable organizational structures, processes, systems, and capabilities to support rapid business growth. Build and develop a strong leadership team and establish a performance-driven, accountable organizational culture. Maintain strong relationships with customers, strategic partners, government entities, and other key stakeholders. Ensure appropriate governance, safety, risk management, and regulatory compliance as the organization expands. Candidate Profile Minimum 12 years of relevant experience , including at least 5 years in a senior leadership capacity . Strong background within land transportation, logistics, fleet management, or a closely related sector . Proven track record of growing, scaling, or significantly expanding a business , with tangible achievements in revenue growth, market penetration, new customer acquisition, or business expansion. Strong business development and commercial orientation combined with solid transportation and fleet operational expertise. Demonstrated P&L ownership and strong understanding of profitability, cost structures, investment decisions, and asset utilization. Experience leading sizeable operational workforces and multidisciplinary teams. Exposure to digital transformation, fleet technology, automation, or transportation management systems is highly desirable. Entrepreneurial, hands-on, and highly results-oriented leadership style. Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Finance, Logistics, or a related discipline; an MBA is preferred. Interested candidates with a demonstrated record of building and scaling transportation businesses are invited to apply or share their profile for confidential consideration.

results.title: Last Mile Operations Manager
results.location: Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
results.description: We operate autonomous delivery vehicles in the UAE. This role owns whether those deliveries actually land — on time, without failure, without a complaint. Once a customer is live and vehicles are on the road, the fulfilment flow is yours: order intake, dispatch, pickup, driving, customer handover. You will take it apart, make it measurable, watch it in real time, and drive the fixes. You will lead a team of 2–3. Expect to firefight. Early-stage operations break in ways nobody has documented yet, and you will need to contain problems fast, often on incomplete information. But every incident should leave behind a standard, a monitor, or a fix — we will judge you on how fast you contain today’s problem, and on how few of them you are still containing three months in. What You’ll Own On-time delivery rate, fulfilment success rate, vehicle utilisation, exception rate and MTTR — the numbers this role is measured on. Fulfilment standards and SOPs that our field and service teams run on. Real-time monitoring and the escalation model — with a documented root cause for every major failure. Turning field problems into prioritised, evidence-backed asks for product and engineering — and following through until the metric moves. What You’ll Need Essential 3–5 years in last-mile delivery, on-demand logistics, ride-hailing, quick commerce or fleet operations. Proven ability to build process, not just run it — you have taken a messy operation, decomposed it, and made it repeatable by others. This matters more to us than years of management. A metric you personally moved , and the story of how. SQL and BI — you pull and cut your own data rather than queuing behind an analyst. Skilled with AI tools — you build your own dashboards, analyses or prototypes instead of waiting on someone else. A track record of driving fixes through teams you don’t manage . Hands-on operating experience in the UAE or wider GCC . Fluent English; based in Abu Dhabi or ready to relocate. Preferred Autonomous vehicle, delivery robot or teleoperation background. Arabic. Team leadership experience. Zero-to-one market launch. What We Offer Competitive package benchmarked to the UAE market. Company-provided AI tool subscriptions. Visa sponsored. Ownership of UAE fulfilment performance in a business building autonomous delivery operations from zero — very few companies in the region are doing this — with a team of 2–3 from day one. This is an early-stage business: frequent problems, fast pace, processes still being written. If that is the environment you do your best work in, this role will give you more of it than most. results.title: Senior Director - Road/Land Freight
results.description: Job Summary: The role will lead and manage P&L, operations, and business growth for trucking fleets and lead teams, win new business, improve network safety, and ensure high on-time delivery rates across the GCC network Key Responsibilities Commercial Accountability Grow revenue and gross margin for the road freight division. Build pricing models and bid strategies for new customer contracts. Secure new business and keep key client accounts happy. Work with sales teams to pitch integrated 3PL solutions. Operations Accountability Oversee daily truckload (TL) and less-than-truckload (LTL) transport performance. Track metrics like on-time delivery, cost per mile, and asset utilization. Manage carrier relationships, partner networks, and subcontractor rates. Drive continuous improvement in transit times and route planning. Team Leadership Lead operations managers, dispatchers, and sales account leads. Set clear performance goals and run regular team reviews. Hire, train, and mentor staff to build a strong workplace culture. Ensure all drivers and staff follow health, safety, and labor laws. Qualifications & Skills Experience: 8+ years in logistics or 3PL, with 4+ years in a senior leadership role. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, or a related field. Skills: Strong budget management, contract negotiation, and data analysis. Knowledge: Deep understanding of road freight markets, Hours of Service (HOS) rules, and TMS technology.

results.title: Manager, Micro Mobility Operations
results.description: Redefining Land, Air, and Sea Travel… Elevating Destinations. Coastal Transportation Services Co., a Red Sea Global Subsidiary Coastal Transportation Services Company, a subsidiary of Red Sea Global, provides Transportation services at our Red Sea destination and is part of the Red Sea Global Group of companies. We specialize in providing transportation services to our Red Sea destination. As a subsidiary, Coastal Transportation Services Co. benefits from shared strategic goals and collaborative initiatives within the Red Sea Global group of companies, enhancing our ability to serve our clients effectively. Are you ready to transform the future of transportation? At Coastal Transportation Services Co., we are driven by innovation, creativity, and a passion for redefining transportation. Our team is shaping the future with cutting-edge projects, from autonomous vehicles to sustainable transportation solutions. We are seeking forward-thinking individuals eager to collaborate in a dynamic, fast-paced environment where ideas become reality. Join us in revolutionizing transportation and creating a smarter, more sustainable world—one innovation at a time. Join our visionary team and help shape the future of transportation! Job Purpose: To lead the operational planning, coordination, and continuous improvement of micro mobility services across the organization’s properties. This role is responsible for ensuring seamless delivery of buggy, e-bike, and other micro mobility solutions, supporting the wider Mobility strategy. The position holds accountability for service delivery, stakeholder engagement, team leadership and operational efficiency in a 24/7 environment. Key Responsibilities: Service Operations Leadership Manage daily micro mobility operations across multiple service types and locations. Ensure service continuity, timely asset availability and operational resilience. Support integration of new modes (e.g., e-bikes, scooters) as part of service expansion. Team and Resource Management Lead supervisory staff, operators, and support teams across the micro mobility network. Set clear expectations and performance standards aligned with safety and customer service. Oversee training, onboarding, and staff scheduling to meet service requirements. Performance and Compliance Oversight Ensure all services operate within regulatory, safety and policy frameworks. Monitor service metrics and deliver improvement plans to enhance efficiency and user satisfaction. Implement incident management protocols and ensure timely resolution of issues. Stakeholder Engagement Act as key point of contact for operational queries, escalations, and service coordination. Work cross-functionally with departments including Land Operations, TOCC, Maintenance and Projects. Liaise with vendors and partners to support service delivery and infrastructure readiness. Planning and Development Support service expansion through structured operational plans and asset deployment strategies. Drive forward innovation and technology adoption within micro mobility operations. Assist in the development of SOPs, risk assessments and operational documentation. Reporting and Communication Provide regular operational updates, service performance reports and improvement proposals. Ensure consistent communication across teams and with leadership. Profile Requirements Experience in operations or transport leadership, preferably within micro mobility or fleet services. Proven ability to manage teams in fast-paced, high-visibility environments. Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate across functions and resolve challenges quickly. Operational mindset with the ability to lead services at both strategic and frontline levels. Adaptable and resourceful, with a commitment to service excellence.

results.title: Director of Logistics
results.description: Logistics Director – Saudi Arabia A leading organisation is seeking an experienced Logistics Director to oversee and lead all logistics operations for a major, high-profile development project in Saudi Arabia. This is a senior, site-based leadership position responsible for developing and implementing the overall logistics strategy and ensuring the efficient movement of people, materials, equipment, vehicles, and resources across the project. The role will operate on a hybrid basis between Riyadh and the project site , with a strong site presence required to manage day-to-day logistics activities and coordinate closely with project leadership, contractors, consultants, and key stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Provide strategic leadership and overall direction for all project logistics and site logistics operations . Develop, implement, and continuously improve the project-wide logistics strategy, plans, procedures, and control systems . Oversee the movement, delivery, storage, and distribution of construction materials, plant, equipment, and other resources. Manage site access, traffic management, vehicle movements, laydown areas, storage facilities, delivery scheduling, and logistics compounds . Coordinate logistics requirements across multiple contractors, consultants, suppliers, and project teams to minimise disruption and maximise site efficiency. Establish effective systems for delivery management, material flow, site transportation, and resource allocation . Work closely with construction, engineering, procurement, commercial, HSE, security, and programme teams to ensure logistics activities align with overall project requirements. Monitor logistics performance, identify potential constraints and bottlenecks, and implement proactive solutions to maintain programme progress. Lead the planning and coordination of logistics requirements during different phases of construction and project development. Ensure all logistics activities comply with relevant HSE requirements, Saudi regulations, project standards, and operational procedures . Manage logistics-related risks, developing mitigation strategies and contingency plans where required. Provide regular reporting to senior project leadership on logistics performance, risks, constraints, resource requirements, and upcoming activities. Lead and develop logistics teams, promoting a strong culture of collaboration, accountability, safety, and continuous improvement. Liaise with local authorities, transport providers, suppliers, and other external stakeholders where required. Support the wider project leadership team in resolving complex logistical challenges and ensuring the project remains on programme. Candidate Profile The successful candidate will be a highly experienced Logistics Director / Senior Logistics Manager with a strong background in major construction, infrastructure, urban development, or mega-project environments. Experience managing logistics across large and complex sites, with multiple contractors and significant volumes of people, materials, and equipment, is highly desirable. The individual should demonstrate: Significant senior-level experience in construction and project logistics . Proven experience developing and implementing logistics strategies for large-scale projects. Strong understanding of site logistics, traffic management, material handling, access management, and supply-chain coordination . Excellent leadership and stakeholder-management capabilities. Strong commercial awareness and an ability to manage logistics efficiently within programme and budget constraints. Excellent communication, planning, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. The ability to operate confidently at both strategic and operational levels . Experience working in Saudi Arabia or the wider GCC would be advantageous. Location & Benefits This is a hybrid role , with the successful candidate working between Riyadh and the project site in Saudi Arabia . A regular and significant site presence will be required due to the operational nature of the position. When working on site, the package includes: Site allowance payable for time spent on site. Flights between Riyadh and the relevant site location. Hotel accommodation when required. Accommodation and transportation provided in connection with the site assignment. Opportunity to work on a major, high-profile development programme in Saudi Arabia.

results.title: Senior Director: Mobility Planner
results.description: In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next! At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible. Job Description **Join a Landmark Giga-Project Shaping the Future of Saudi Arabia** Our client is delivering one of the Kingdom’s most ambitious and high-profile giga-projects, set to redefine global standards in destination development, innovation, and visitor experience. As part of the integrated Delivery Partner team, you will play a key role in planning, designing, and implementing world-class assets and infrastructure that support the Kingdom’s Vision 2030. This is a unique opportunity to contribute to a pioneering program at scale, working alongside industry-leading experts, cutting-edge technologies, and diverse stakeholders. If you are driven by challenge, motivated by impact, and eager to be part of a legacy project that will influence generations to come, we invite you to consider joining this transformative journey. The Senior Director: Mobility Planner is the ultimate technical, operational, and strategic authority responsible for the end-to-end planning, efficiency, and day-to-day management of the city’s multi-modal mobility network. With a mandate requiring extensive distinguished leadership experience, this executive-level leader oversees the live operations of the entire transportation ecosystem. This includes public transit systems, autonomous shuttle corridors, active mobility trails, parking networks, micro-mobility, and intelligent traffic management systems. Sitting firmly within the O&M division, this role focuses on maximizing network throughput, minimizing congestion, deploying next-generation smart-city mobility technologies, and ensuring safe, seamless, and sustainable journeys for millions of annual residents and visitors. Key Responsibilities Multi-Modal Network & Transit Operations (O&M) Direct the daily operations, transit scheduling, and fleet management of all public and private transportation systems, including buses, light rail/monorail, micro-mobility, and autonomous mass transit networks. Oversee the strategic implementation of active mobility frameworks, managing pedestrian corridors, bike networks, and scooter-sharing infrastructure to ensure perfect connectivity between major city hubs and entertainment districts. Serve as the principal authority for high-footfall event transport planning, designing mega-crowd traffic diversion models, park-and-ride strategies, and flexible transit surges to handle peak visitor loads seamlessly. Formulate robust emergency transportation plans, network redundancy routes, and incident-response protocols to guarantee zero-disruption mobility during grid failures or civil emergencies. Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) & Traffic Engineering Direct the operational deployment and tuning of the city's Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), including adaptive traffic signals, automated speed enforcement, and real-time transit information displays. Partner with the digital city operations hub to leverage real-time traffic flow telemetry, predictive AI congestion mapping, and IoT sensor loops to optimize vehicle movements city-wide. Act as the technical authority for the city's smart car parks, integrating automated parking guidance systems (PGS), automated billing, license plate recognition (LPR), and electric vehicle (EV) charging grids with the broader mobility network. Financial Cost Recovery & Asset Integration Translate multi-modal usage logs, public transit ticketing data, and shared mobility fees into automated financial models for corporate finance teams. Provide the Service Charge Director with audited transit-wear metrics to ensure equitable infrastructure cross-charging, charging commercial zones, theme parks, and venues their fair share for the mobility infrastructure feeding their districts. Collaborate with the Asset Lifecycle Planning (LCP) division to map out multi-decade Capital Asset Replacement Plans (CARP) for core mobility infrastructure (e.g., transit fleets, smart charging arrays, signals, and ITS servers). Partner with the SAP-EAMS team to ensure every vehicle, charging dock, traffic sensor, and transit station is assigned a flawless digital ID for data-driven, predictive maintenance scheduling. Stage-Gate Handover & Design Advisory Serve as the primary mobility gatekeeper on the Stage-Gate Handover Committee, auditing traffic impact assessments (TIAs) and multi-modal readiness before newly constructed transit corridors or roads transition into live city operations. Formulate rigorous testing and commissioning verification rules for all transit fleets and smart ITS software networks prior to full operational adoption from builders and vendors. Job Requirements & Qualifications Education & Professional Credentials Bachelor’s Degree in Transportation Planning, Civil Engineering, Urban Design, Traffic Engineering, or a highly relevant quantitative technical discipline from an accredited institution. Master’s Degree in Transportation Engineering, Smart Mobility, Urban Planning, or an MBA from a globally recognized institution is highly preferred. Professional Certifications: Active senior professional registration, such as a Chartered Engineer (CEng), Professional Engineer (PE), or certification from the American Institute of Certified Planners (AICP) / Institute of Transportation Engineers (ITE). Experience 20+ years of progressive, distinguished leadership experience in multi-modal urban transit planning, large-scale traffic engineering, or smart city mobility operations. At least 8 years in a senior executive or director-level capacity, directly managing multi-disciplinary transport teams and multi-million-dollar mobility operational and capital budgets (OPEX/CAPEX). Proven track record of spearheading the operational setup, network routing, or post-construction integration of giga-scale mass transit networks, autonomous vehicle testbeds, or smart-city traffic frameworks. Deep experience navigating micro-mobility logistics, fleet electrification challenges, demand-side traffic management, and Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 sustainability and smart city targets. Technical & Soft Skills Deep technical command over macro and micro traffic simulation modeling software (e.g., PTV VISSIM, VISUM, Synchro, or equivalent platforms). Executive-level fluency in transport operational technologies, including fleet telematics, automated fare collection (AFC) engines, and SAP Enterprise Asset Management (EAMS) integrations. results.title: Service Delivery Lead (Fleet) - Dubai
results.description: #WeAreAverda About Averda Averda is a leading global provider of integrated waste management and environmental services, delivering innovative, sustainable solutions to some of the world’s most complex waste challenges. Operating across multiple markets, we are committed to transforming waste into value while safeguarding the environment, supporting our communities, and driving operational excellence. Overview We are looking for a Service Delivery Lead to take ownership of daily vehicle deployment, route planning, fleet utilization and logistics coordination to ensure safe, efficient and uninterrupted waste collection operations. Key Responsibilities Lead and coordinate daily vehicle deployment and resource allocation for waste collection operations, monitoring daily fulfilment and targeting zero missed collections. Plan, optimize, and maintain records of collection routes, vehicle schedules, fleet utilization, and deployment methods to maximize productivity and minimize downtime. Ensure timely vehicle dispatch and coordinate effective responses to breakdowns, emergencies, operational changes, and service disruptions. Monitor vehicle movements and ensure adherence to planned routes, schedules, and operational requirements. Manage and follow up on all fleet-related transactions and documentation, including vehicle transfers, registrations, Rasid renewals, GPS activations, permits, and other regulatory requirements. Maintain accurate and up-to-date fleet, asset, and inventory records, ensuring all transactions and changes are properly documented. Monitor vehicle availability, breakdowns, maintenance requirements, fuel consumption, utilization, and overall fleet performance, including tracking open action items and future fleet requirements. Ensure compliance with company SOPs, road permits requirements, client requirements, and applicable UAE regulations. Coordinate closely with Drivers, Helpers, LDSC Agents, Dispatchers, Workshop/Maintenance, HSE, Stores, and other Operations teams to ensure operational issues and action items are properly managed and closed in accordance with SOPs. Lead and support Drivers, Helpers, and Dispatch/Operations teams while promoting a strong culture of safety, accountability, discipline, and operational excellence. Monitor and analyze key operational KPIs, including Vehicle Utilization, Daily Dispatch Percentage, Daily Fulfilment Percentage, Trips, Route Adherence, Productivity, Delays, Fuel Consumption, Missed Collections, and Service Completion. Identify and implement opportunities for route optimization, cost reduction, improved fleet utilization, higher productivity, and enhanced service quality. Maintain accurate records for Drivers, Helpers, and other Frontliners, including attendance, leave, incidents, accidents, disciplinary matters, and related operational actions. Prepare and maintain the monthly incentive and KPI calculations for Frontliners and Operations teams, ensuring accuracy and timely completion. Conduct regular coordination meetings with Sales and Key Account teams and ensure operational requirements, service requests, and customer complaints are properly actioned. Ensure monthly operational reports for Key Account customers are prepared and shared within the required timelines. Maintain strong working relationships with Key Account customers, ensuring operational requirements and service concerns are addressed promptly. Attend customer meetings, site visits, and operational reviews as required. Support Sales and Commercial teams in assessing new projects, including calculating operational requirements, manpower, fleet and equipment requirements, productivity assumptions, and operational costing. Continuously review fleet and operational processes to identify opportunities for automation, improved controls, better resource utilization, cost efficiency, and service improvement. Qualifications & Experience 7-8 years of experience in Waste management operations. Strong knowledge of vehicle routing, fleet scheduling, GPS tracking, and fleet management system, DM and Sharjah municipality permits Experience managing a fleet of heavy and light commercial vehicles. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with good knowledge of MS Excel and operational reporting. Excellent communication, coordination, and team leadership skills. Good knowledge of UAE roads and operational requirements. Valid UAE Driving License is preferred. Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Transport, Business Administration, or a related discipline. If you think you have what it takes to make the world a cleaner place, if you can see value where others see waste and if you aren’t afraid of a challenge, why not start your journey with us today. Averda welcomes candidates from all backgrounds, actively promotes diversity in the workforce, and is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. ONLY SHORTLISTED CANDIDATES WILL BE CONTACTED*

results.title: Assistant Manager Logistics Operations
results.description: Talabat is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. Job Description As an Assistant Manager, you will own the performance of operations - spanning the bicycle and EV fleet and tMart operations. You will be expected to operate independently, drive compliance, and work closely with cross-functional teams to improve how the fleet runs. Responsibilities Own the operational strategy and performance of the fleet - optimizing the fleet mix across bicycles and EVs, and setting the roadmap in collaboration with stakeholders. Track and analyze fleet performance metrics, translating data into structured updates and clear recommendations for leadership. Drive compliance at tMarts - visiting regularly, ensuring riders are showing up and following protocols, with consistent enforcement and a clear action plan for violators. Identify and drive long-term solutions to recurring operational challenges. Continuously refine and improve SOPs - leveraging automation and system enhancements to drive efficiency and reduce manual dependency. Drive cross-functional collaboration with Performance, 3PL, and Rider Lifecycle teams to resolve systemic issues and align on priorities. Build a high-performing team, foster a culture of ownership and accountability, with clear communication, and alignment across city-level operations. Qualifications Education and Experience: Bachelor’s Degree required. Master’s preferred. 3-5 years of experience in operations, ideally in last-mile delivery, e-commerce, or mobility tech. Proven experience managing on-ground teams and working across functions. Skills And Competencies Analytical thinking with a data-driven approach to decision-making. Clear, structured communication across teams and seniority levels. Strong ownership mindset — accountable for outcomes, not just outputs. On-ground presence — comfortable in the field and confident making independent calls. Proven stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills. Beginner to intermediate proficiency with AI tools, including Claude.

results.title: Transportation Supervisor
results.description: About the Role We are looking for an experienced Transport Supervisor to oversee and coordinate daily transportation operations between the Distribution Center (DC) and assigned dark store locations across Kuwait . The role will be responsible for ensuring the timely and efficient movement of goods from the DC to dark stores, managing delivery routes and schedules, overseeing truck fleet operations and utilization , monitoring driver performance, and maintaining high standards of operational efficiency and service quality. The Transport Supervisor will also be responsible for route planning and optimization, delivery allocation, truck fleet management, vehicle utilization and availability, driver coordination, transportation performance tracking, and managing operational issues and delays . The role will work closely with DC and dark store teams to ensure smooth and reliable replenishment operations, minimize delivery delays, optimize transportation resources, and ensure that dark stores receive the required inventory on time. Key Responsibilities Manage daily transportation operations from the Distribution Center (DC) to assigned dark store locations , ensuring timely, safe, and efficient movement of goods and smooth execution of replenishment plans. Plan, coordinate, and optimize transport routes, delivery schedules, truck allocation, and delivery capacity based on business requirements, store demand, and operational priorities. Manage and monitor the truck fleet , including vehicle availability, utilization, deployment, maintenance coordination, and overall fleet efficiency. Coordinate and supervise drivers and transport teams , ensuring adherence to delivery schedules, assigned routes, operational procedures, safety requirements, and service standards. Monitor daily transportation performance and key KPIs, including on-time delivery, route efficiency, vehicle utilization, delivery turnaround time, transportation costs, and service quality . Track deliveries in real time, identify delays, route deviations, vehicle issues, and other transportation exceptions, and take timely corrective actions to minimize operational disruptions. Coordinate closely with DC, dark store, warehouse, operations, and other relevant teams to ensure accurate loading, dispatch, receiving, and timely replenishment of dark stores. Identify, investigate, and resolve transportation-related operational issues and delivery exceptions, conducting root-cause analysis and implementing corrective and preventive actions. Analyze transportation data and operational trends to identify opportunities for route optimization, fleet utilization, cost reduction, and process improvement . Ensure compliance with company transportation policies, fleet safety standards, vehicle requirements, driver procedures, and applicable local regulations . Oversee the training and development of drivers and transport team members, ensuring they have the required operational knowledge, safety awareness, and service standards. Prepare regular transportation performance reports and provide data-driven insights and recommendations to management on fleet performance, route efficiency, operational issues, and improvement opportunities. Support the development and continuous optimization of transportation processes, route planning, fleet management, and DC-to-dark-store delivery operations to improve efficiency, reliability, and overall service quality. Job Requirements Bachelor's degree or higher in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration , or a related field; alternatively, 3+ years of relevant experience in transport, logistics, or delivery operations . Proven experience in delivery, transport, logistics, fleet, preferably within a fast-paced e-commerce or delivery environment. Strong communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across multiple teams. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret operational data and identify performance improvement opportunities. Strong execution and follow-up skills, with the ability to work effectively under pressure in a fast-paced environment. Good project management and process improvement capabilities. Fluent in English , with strong written and verbal communication skills. Willingness to be based in Kuwait and work according to operational requirements, including flexible working hours when necessary.

results.title: Logistics & Interface Manager
results.description: In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next! At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible. Job Description In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next! At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible. Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented Interface & Logistics Manager to join our team! In this role you will get to lead and manage all technical and operational interfaces between multiple parties while planning and controlling logistics to ensure safe, efficient, and timely delivery of major infrastructure works. Position Overview: The Interface & Logistics Manager will lead and manage all technical and operational interfaces between multiple contractors, consultants, stakeholders, and authorities on the project, while planning and controlling logistics to ensure safe, efficient and timely delivery of works. The role is a key part of Parsons’ PMC team, acting as a central coordination point to avoid scope gaps, conflicts and delays across all packages. What You'll Be Doing Interface Management Developing, implementing, and maintaining the Project Interface Management Plan in alignment with Parsons PMC procedures and client requirements. Establishing and managing interface tools including Interface Register, Interface Matrix, Scope Delineation and Interface Agreement Forms for all contracts and disciplines. Identifying, categorizing, and tracking all interface points between infrastructure packages (roads, utilities, buildings, transportation, ITS, etc.) and external stakeholders (authorities, operators, third parties). Coordinating and chairing regular interface coordination meetings between contractors, consultants, and client, ensuring timely resolution of interface issues and clear action ownership. Defining and implementing escalation paths for interface conflicts, including technical and contractual escalation to Parsons management and client leadership when required. Reviewing and validating contractors’ interface-related drawings, method statements, and programmes to ensure alignment at tie-in points, corridors, and shared assets. Managing interface dependencies and constraints to minimize rework, claims, and delays, ensuring full alignment between design, construction, testing, and commissioning activities. Supporting change management and claims avoidance by providing interface impact assessments and recommendations to Parsons PMC and the client. Logistics Management Developing and overseeing the Project Logistics Plan covering materials delivery, site access, laydown areas, traffic management, temporary facilities, and construction sequencing. Coordinating logistics across multiple contractors to optimize use of corridors, access roads, storage areas, and cranes/equipment, avoiding conflicts and unsafe conditions. Working with contractors to plan and schedule material deliveries, heavy transport, and critical lifts, ensuring compliance with local authority regulations and project HSSE requirements. Monitoring and managing logistics KPIs (delivery performance, congestion, utilization, etc.) using PMIS and other tools and proposing corrective actions where needed. Ensuring integration of logistics plans with interface constraints, utility diversions, and phased handovers, particularly in live or sensitive operational environments. You'll own the operational commercials and KPI performance, drive the optimization work that improves efficiency and experience, and turn analysis into decisions. It's a role for someone equally comfortable in a model and in a room full of directors, someone who can read the data and stand their ground on what it means . What's on your plate? Commercial & P&L Ownership for Operations Own the commercials behind UAE operations, cost-per-order, rider cost, and the efficiency metrics that drive the operational P&L. Track budget vs. actuals, protect riders and 3pls earnings, and give leadership clear, data-backed trade-offs between cost, growth, and customer experience. Anticipate performance gaps before they hit the P&L and drive the interventions that close them. Run the reporting and executive reviews that keep leadership decision-ready. Operational Optimization Drive the optimization agenda across the network: rider economics and staffing efficiency, vendor and coverage performance, area-level improvements.
